description: This file defines the SparkStatusTracker class, which provides low-level APIs for monitoring job and stage progress within Apache Spark. It includes methods for retrieving job IDs by group or tag, active stage and job IDs, detailed job and stage info, and executor information.

classes.name: SparkStatusTracker
classes.description: A class providing APIs for monitoring Spark job and stage statuses, including retrieving job IDs, stage IDs, job and stage info, and executor details.

methods.name: getJobIdsForGroup
methods.description: Returns job IDs associated with a specific job group, or all jobs if null.

methods.name: getJobIdsForTag
methods.description: Returns job IDs associated with a specific tag.

methods.name: getActiveStageIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of all active stages.

methods.name: getActiveJobIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of all active jobs.

methods.name: getJobInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific job by ID, or None if not found.

methods.name: getStageInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific stage by ID, or None if not found.

methods.name: getExecutorInfos
methods.description: Returns information about all known executors, including host, port, cache size, and memory metrics.
